files_one_logo_per_operator.name: files_one_logo_per_operator
files_one_logo_per_operator.where: "files"."purpose" = 'operator_logo' and "files"."confirmed_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_at" is null

files_vehicle_purposes.name: files_vehicle_purposes
files_vehicle_purposes.value:
("files"."purpose"::text not in ('vehicle_photo', 'vehicle_photo_thumbnail', 'vehicle_document') or "files"."vehicle_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'operator_logo' or "files"."vehicle_id" is null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text = 'vehicle_photo_thumbnail') = ("files"."thumbnail_of_file_id" is not null)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text in ('vehicle_photo', 'vehicle_document', 'vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment')) = ("files"."label" is not null)

files_attachment_links.name: files_attachment_links
files_attachment_links.value:
num_nonnulls("files"."registration_id", "files"."policy_id", "files"."cost_id", "files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id")
          = (case when "files"."purpose"::text in ('vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment') then 1 else 0 end)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'vehicle_identity_attachment' or num_nonnulls("files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id") = 1)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text <> 'vehicle_attachment' or num_nonnulls("files"."purchase_id", "files"."sale_id") = 0)
        and ("files"."purpose"::text not in ('vehicle_attachment', 'vehicle_identity_attachment') or ("files"."policy_id" is null) = ("files"."vehicle_id" is not null))

vehicles_one_vin_per_operator.name: vehicles_one_vin_per_operator
vehicles_one_vin_per_operator.where: "vehicles"."vin" is not null and "vehicles"."archived_at" is null

vehicles_status_return_details.name: vehicles_status_return_details
vehicles_status_return_details.value:
("vehicles"."status" in ('in_service', 'off_road')) = ("vehicles"."status_reason" is not null and "vehicles"."status_expected_back" is not null)
        and ("vehicles"."status_reason" is null) = ("vehicles"."status_expected_back" is null)

vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry.name: vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry
vehicle_registrations_one_per_expiry.where: "vehicle_registrations"."archived_at" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is not null

vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit.name: vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit
vehicle_registrations_one_direct_debit.where: "vehicle_registrations"."archived_at" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is null and "vehicle_registrations"."direct_debit_stopped_on" is null

vehicle_registrations_direct_debit.name: vehicle_registrations_direct_debit
vehicle_registrations_direct_debit.value:
("vehicle_registrations"."term_months" = 1) = ("vehicle_registrations"."expires_on" is null)
        and ("vehicle_registrations"."direct_debit_stopped_on" is null or "vehicle_registrations"."term_months" = 1)
